description: This file defines the 'Search' model class within the 'Opencart\Catalog\Model\Account' namespace, responsible for handling customer search data within the OpenCart system. It contains methods for adding customer search records to the database.

classes.name: Search
classes.description: Model class for handling customer search data in the Account namespace.

methods.name: addSearch
methods.description: Inserts a customer search record into the database with data such as store ID, language ID, customer ID, keyword, category ID, sub-category flag, description, products, IP address, and timestamp.
